decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate builds directly on the firm's core agricultural crate expertise and in-house development, so it can interpret results and refine the product.
Foldable large containers are central to the firm's returnable packaging know-how and were prominently featured with their own page, indicating strong fit and commitment.
Stackable plastic crates are the firm's core competence, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is easy to sustain and improve.
Rackable pallets sit squarely within the firm's pallet engineering knowledge, allowing it to learn from market feedback.

Spill-retention pallets are a more specialised niche slightly farther from returnable transport packaging and were downgraded from their own page, but they remain related enough for the firm's in-house R&D to support them.
A pallet with load retainers is a close extension of existing pallet designs, although its reduced web presence suggests somewhat lower priority.
